chunks: From him, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'He is not one of us who plots against a Muslim.'
ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet mean by 'He is not from us' regarding those who plot against Muslims?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith defines 'makar' (strategic deception or plotting) as a marker of identity, excluding the deceiver from the Prophet's community. In Shia scholarship, this is often interpreted not merely as simple lying, but as a deeper, calculated treachery that undermines trust (amanah) within the social fabric. It serves as a foundational principle for ethical conduct, linking internal sincerity with external social reliability.
